about_the_game:
A set of DLC-exclusive mascots inspired by the adventures on the Isle of Seiren. Mascots can be displayed anywhere onscreen.

Isle of Seiren: Adol
Isle of Seiren: Dana
Isle of Seiren: Raksha
Isle of Seiren: Sahad
Isle of Seiren: Hummel
Isle of Seiren: Ricotta
Isle of Seiren: Dogi
Isle of Seiren: Little Paro

*Open [DLC] under [Items] in the main menu and select new items to receive them.
*After receiving items, place mascots via [Items] -> [Used Items] in the main menu.
